Neha — thanks, I read the options. Approvals and conditions below.

- Option A: APPROVED. I can sign off on 18% discount + $25k onboarding credit. No further escalation required.
- PoC credit: we can pre-authorize a $10k PoC credit immediately for Atlas. That will be issued as a one-time credit on the first invoice; note we will tag it to the deal and require a short form PoC acceptance form.
- Option B: CONDITIONAL. 25% discount + $50k onboarding credit requires CRO approval and finance confirmation on receivable risk for net-60 terms. If Atlas confirms a stronger commit cadence (e.g., 60% upfront on the 18mo), we can move to CRO approval route faster.

Action items I own:
- Rafael: notify Finance and request a fast-track for a one-time net-60 exception for Atlas (ETA: EOD Thu Apr 15).
- Rafael: approve Option A in our pricing system and draft the approval note for Marissa to attach to the contract (ETA: Wed Apr 14 morning).

Marissa: please start the redline and include a short clause for PoC credit recoupment and requirement for PO number on first invoice if they want net-60.

I'll also propose a $5k onboarding acceleration credit if they sign before Apr 29 (marketing-led incentive) — doesn't change the above gating approvals.
